entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_EXIT_AFTER_STOP_DELAY` environment variable to automatically exit SDK mode after a specified idle duration, useful for automated workflows and scripts
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_EXIT_AFTER_STOP_DELAY`环境变量，以在指定的空闲持续时间后自动退出 SDK 模式，对于自动化工作流程和脚本非常有用

entries.en: Improve fuzzy search results when searching commands
entries.zh: 改进搜索命令时的模糊匹配结果

entries.en: Improved VS Code extension to respect `chat.fontSize` and `chat.fontFamily` settings throughout the entire UI, and apply font changes immediately without requiring reload
entries.zh: 改进 VS Code 扩展：整个界面都遵循 `chat.fontSize` 和 `chat.fontFamily` 设置，字体修改立即生效，无需重新加载

entries.en: Migrated `ignorePatterns` from project config to deny permissions in the localSettings.
entries.zh: 将 `ignorePatterns` 从项目配置迁移为 localSettings 中的拒绝权限

entries.en: Fixed menu navigation getting stuck on items with empty string or other falsy values (e.g., in the `/hooks` menu)
entries.zh: 修复了菜单导航卡在具有空字符串或其他虚假值的项目上的问题（例如，在`/hooks`菜单中）
